contact.name: Mark Simpson
contact.evidence_quote: Mark Simpson ... Mark Simpson has been with the City of Shawnee since 2010, and most recently served as Battalion Chief in the City of Shawnee Fire Department. Prior to working for the City, he worked in the private sector focusing on water cleaning infrastructure, associated products and services, and equipment sales. Mark was brought on as the Assistant City Manager in July 2024, made Acting City Manager, Interim City Manager in January 2025, and appointed City Manager in September 2025.
